confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on a few current New Orleans menus plus one crowd-sourced cost-of-living figure, so they are moderately reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are bounded estimates from thin local data, a national 2026 benchmark, and the local beer relationship. Inexpensive and mid-range meals are estimates informed by the same sources, not audited surveys. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context, not from inspected booking pages or current listings. The FX observation came from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on New Orleans-specific menu and cost-of-living data points, with a 2026 US national guide used for cocktail and wine levels and local beer pricing as a reference. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-size US tourism city in July.
